name: Brill (books)
description: Book manuscripts for Brill: indented paragraphs, headings numbered decimally in arabic numerals, footnotes numbered anew in every chapter, a separate bibliography, and a manuscript anonymised for review.

source.name: Brill's Author Guide (PDF of April 2026)
source.notes: Not specified, and taken from the general default: margins, font size, line spacing, alignment, the amount of indentation, the typographic form of headings (only a clear and consistent distinction, in title case, is asked for; more than four levels are to be avoided), the block-quotation threshold ('larger sections of quoted text'), size and spacing of notes, layout of the bibliography, page numbers. The page size is not stated: A4 was chosen for a European publisher. Brill encourages its own typeface, 'Brill', and otherwise asks for Unicode fonts. The first line of a paragraph is indented, except after a blank line, a heading or a block quotation. Block quotations have a blank line before and after. A running title of at most 60 characters is supplied for each chapter, apart from the manuscript. Abstract and keywords: about 200 words and about 6-10 keywords for each contribution to an edited volume; for monographs a short abstract of each chapter, in a separate file. Brill has no single house style for references: it recommends the Chicago Manual of Style or the Oxford Style Manual, and by field Harvard or MLA (arts), Bluebook or OSCOLA (law), APA (social sciences and linguistics); so no reference style is given. Repeated authors' names in the bibliography are not replaced by dashes. A PDF identical to the Word file is always wanted.

limits.note: For contributions to edited volumes: an abstract of about 200 words and about 6-10 keywords. The total word count, bibliography and footnotes included, is reported with the proposal.
